name: opportunityloop
description: OpportunityLoop — Explainable Student Opportunity & Participation Hub

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.dev:memory: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev:memory" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
